exposure: cervical ripening agent (dinoprostone, misoprostol, or cervical catheter)
outcome: neonatal admission to triage or intensive care unit (ICU) after delivery
cohort: 192 nulliparous overweight and obese women who underwent induction of labor at two south-central Pennsylvania hospitals between January 2014 and December 2017
finding: Among nulliparous overweight and obese gravidas, neither dinoprostone, misoprostol, or cervical catheter significantly impacted the induction to birth time.
